title: SignalOS: Core Loop
summary: Collect records, mount drives, read archives, and act on the useful signal.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Recover drives, inspect records, install or archive them, use apps for context, and let discovered data point to the next route or system.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each record, decide whether it changes a mission, route, recipe, or warning. Archive the rest so the signal stays readable.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop when the terminal has given you the next step. Label the drive and move before the search becomes another inventory problem.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
